name: Weighted Pointer
summary: Error-aware gaze pointing that blends gaze with fallback modalities such as head or controller when eye tracking is unreliable.
howItWorks: The pointer combines several inputs, weighting each by its expected error, so selection stays accurate when gaze data degrades.
